row: A.E.R.O. Animal Education and Rescue Organziation

Welcome to A Day in the Life of a Rehabber!

Join us behind the scenes at A.E.R.O., where we rescue, rehabilitate, and release injured and orphaned wildlife in northern Virginia. Our video blog takes you into the daily routines, challenges, and heartwarming moments of wildlife rehab. From animal intake and medical care to release day, we’re here to educate, inspire, and share the incredible stories of the animals we help. Subscribe to learn about the vital work of wildlife rescue and discover how you can make a difference for our native wildlife!
